inputs.text: A single environment concept tile for a dark fantasy action RPG: the whole interior of one small, closed gothic hall read from a high three-quarter isometric game angle. Bone-white ash masonry with cold iron fittings and battered iron fittings at the corners, and a single blood-red carpet running from a low gate at one end up to two steps of dais at the other. On the dais stands one tall gothic throne: a spined back crowned by a skull finial, wide flat arms, pale banners hung flat on the wall behind it. Free-standing iron candlesticks line the walls and flank the carpet, burning cold green candle flame, and a pale word glows above the seat. There is no gate, arch or portal anywhere in the room - the prize there is furniture. Palette strictly muted: obsidian #171719 shadows, charcoal #29282B stone, bone #C6BDAA worn edges and banners, blood burgundy #642A32 carpet, antique gold #A98A50 only on the throne fittings, no characters, no creatures, no user interface, no readable text.
